# Soumil Garg

> Soumil Garg runs Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads for D2C brands in the US and India. He makes the ads, shows you what to fix on the website they land on, and runs the ad account himself.

## What he offers
- Ad creatives: 60 new ads a month (statics, explainer reels, UGC-style videos, motion graphics, founder videos, in English and Hinglish), tested in batches so the winners show up fast.
- Website fixes (CRO): a phone-first review of a store, with a before and after picture and a one-line reason for every change. Top 3 fixes free within 24 hours; the full report is $100.
- Ad account management: he checks every account every morning, sends a WhatsApp note, reports from real store orders, month to month.
